high_level_description: The image is a tweet from a user named "Culture Critic" (@Culture_Crit), who has a verified blue checkmark next to their name. The tweet was posted one day ago. The content of the tweet discusses how ornamentation gives things identity and explains that when unique cultural details are removed, people feel isolated because they no longer own their surroundings. Below the text, there is a grid of eight photographs, each labeled with the name of a different country: Germany, Russia, USA, Nigeria, UAE, China, UK, and Brazil.
